message: Quick summary, the three main considerations, as of 2026: what are the standard answers in the styled-components community and the wider frontend community on when style should be component-local and when global? Cover: the intended use of createGlobalStyle; ThemeProvider versus CSS custom properties as the carrier of design tokens; transient props for variants; whether a parent should style its children; semantic classes read by a stylesheet (BEM-style) versus CSS-in-JS component styles, and how design systems mix the two; and the performance of dynamic interpolations versus CSS variables. Context: a React component library built on styled-components where each component may carry its own styled element, annotations put semantic classes on elements, and one theme component renders a global sheet reading those classes and provides token values through ThemeProvider.
